buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Relevant Experience: The bidder shall possess a minimum of two (02) years o f demonstrable experience in providing paper-based printing services within the State of Kerala, during either the preceding Financial Years or Calendar Years. D ocumentary evidence substantiating such experience shall be furnished along wi th the bid. 2. Registered Office / Head Office: The bidder's Registered Office or Head Offic e shall have been situated within the State of Kerala continuously for a minimum period of three (03) years. Valid documentary proof establishing the same shall be submitted along with the bid. 3. Provision of Design Materials: FCI shall furnish the official FCI logo, prescrib ed fonts and relevant leave particulars of FCI employees for the year 2027 (Keral a) to the successful bidder through electronic mail for incorporation into the 202 7 calendar. 4. Submission of Proof for Approval: Prior to undertaking the final printing, th e successful bidder shall submit the complete calendar artwork, including design and formatting, in PDF/JPEG format through email to FCI for scrutiny and approv al. The design and layout shall conform to the sample specifications enclosed wit h the bid document. Printing shall commence only upon receipt of approval from FCI. 5. Delivery and Distribution: The successful bidder shall bear sole responsibility for the safe, timely and complete delivery of the specified quantities of calendars to all ten (10) designated consignee locations across Kerala, in accordance with the distribution details furnished by FCI. 6. Comprehensive Scope of Services: The contractual obligations shall encom pass the entire range of activities, including designing, artwork preparation, for matting, proof submission, printing, binding, packing, transportation, logistics an d final delivery of the calendars to the designated locations.

7. Delivery Timeline: The entire quantity of calendars shall be printed and delive red to all designated consignee locations within fifteen (15) days from the date o f award of the contract. The successful bidder shall ensure strict adherence to th e stipulated delivery schedule. 8. Quality of Binding Materials: The Twin Loop Wire Binding, binding wires and inner metal hanging hooks shall be of superior quality, robust construction and a dequate durability to ensure proper alignment, secure binding and convenient u sage throughout the calendar year. 9. Statutory Documents: The bidder shall furnish a valid Goods and Services Ta x (GST) Registration Certificate and a valid Income Tax Permanent Account Num ber (PAN) card as part of the mandatory bid documentation. 10. Payment Terms: Payment shall be released only upon the successful completi on of the entire contractual obligation, including receipt and satisfactory delivery of the specified quantity of calendars at all designated consignee locations, subj ect to verification and acceptance by FCI. 11. No Advance or Part Payment: FCI shall not entertain or release any advance payment or interim/part payment under this contract. The successful bidder shall make all necessary financial arrangements to execute and complete the contract ual obligations in their entirety before claiming payment. .
